legal.disclaimer: This is a first draft provided as a starting point. It is not legal advice and may not be complete or appropriate for your jurisdiction. You should have a qualified legal professional review and customize it before publishing.
legal.privacyMetaDescription: Privacy Policy for {app} — how we handle your data.
legal.whoWeAreBody: {app} is operated by <entity></entity>. For privacy inquiries, contact us at <email></email>.
legal.whatWeCollectIntro: We collect only what is necessary to provide the service:
legal.collectAccount: Account information: your name, email address, and a securely hashed password. We also store whether your email has been verified and timestamps for when your account was created or updated.
legal.collectQr: QR code data: for each QR code you create, we store the title, destination URL, style settings (colors, size), and an optional center logo image you upload.
legal.collectEmailLog: Email activity log: we keep a record of transactional emails sent to you (verification and password reset), including the recipient address, subject, template used, and delivery status.
legal.whyWeCollectIntro: We use your data solely to operate {app}:
legal.whyAccount: Account information lets you sign in, manage your codes, and recover your password.
legal.whyQr: QR code data is stored so you can view, edit, regenerate, and download your codes at any time.
legal.whyEmail: Email logs help us troubleshoot delivery issues with verification and password-reset emails.
legal.cookiesBody1: {app} uses a single, essential session cookie to keep you signed in. This cookie is strictly necessary for the service to function and does not track you for advertising or analytics purposes.
legal.cookiesBody2: Because the only cookie we use is strictly necessary for authentication, we do not display a cookie consent banner.
legal.subProcessorsIntro: We use a limited number of third-party services to operate {app}:
legal.subResend: Resend — for sending transactional emails (verification and password reset only).
legal.subBlob: Vercel Blob — for storing uploaded center-logo images in production.
legal.subPostgres: Postgres database hosting — for storing your account and QR code data.
legal.subProcessorsOutro: We do not use any third-party advertising or analytics trackers. We do not sell or share your data with anyone for marketing purposes.
legal.transactionalBody: The only emails we send are transactional: email verification when you sign up and password-reset links when you request them. We do not send marketing emails, newsletters, or promotional content.
legal.yourRightsIntro: You can access and manage your data at any time by signing in to your account. You can:
legal.rightsView: View, edit, or delete any of your QR codes.
legal.rightsDelete: Delete your account entirely. When you delete your account, all your QR codes are permanently removed (cascade delete), and any uploaded logo files are deleted from storage.
legal.yourRightsOutro: For any other requests regarding your data, contact us at <email></email>.
legal.privacyGoverningLawBody: This Privacy Policy is governed by the laws of <jurisdiction></jurisdiction>.
legal.privacyChangesBody: We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. When we do, we will revise the "Last updated" date at the top of this page.
legal.termsMetaDescription: Terms of Service for {app} — rules for using the service.
legal.acceptanceBody: By accessing or using {app}, you agree to be bound by these Terms of Service. If you do not agree to these terms, do not use the service.
legal.descriptionIntro: {app} is a free web application that allows you to:
legal.descGenerate: Generate QR codes from URLs you provide.
legal.descStyle: Style your QR codes with custom colors, sizes, and optional center logos.
legal.descManage: Manage, search, edit, and delete your QR codes through your account.
legal.descDownload: Download your QR codes as PNG or SVG images.
legal.descriptionOutro: The service is provided at no charge and with no limit on the number of QR codes you can create.
legal.howBody: Each QR code you create is generated on demand from the destination URL and style settings you save. The QR code image itself encodes your destination URL directly — we do not use dynamic redirects or track scans. When someone scans your QR code, their device reads the URL from the image and navigates there directly.
legal.acceptableUseIntro: You are responsible for the content your QR codes link to. You agree not to use {app} to create QR codes that point to:
legal.useMalware: Malware, phishing sites, or other harmful destinations.
legal.useIp: Content that infringes on the intellectual property rights of others.
legal.useAbusive: Abusive, harassing, defamatory, or otherwise objectionable material.
legal.acceptableUseOutro: We reserve the right to suspend or terminate accounts that violate these terms.
legal.yourAccountBody: You are responsible for maintaining the security of your account credentials. You agree to notify us immediately if you become aware of any unauthorized use of your account.
legal.terminationIntro: You may delete your account at any time through your account settings. When you delete your account:
legal.termDeleteCodes: All your QR codes are permanently deleted.
legal.termDeleteLogos: Any uploaded logo files are removed from storage.
legal.termDeleteAccount: Your account information is removed from our database.
legal.terminationOutro: We may also terminate or suspend your account if you violate these Terms of Service.
legal.noWarrantyBody: {app} is provided "as is" and "as available" without warranties of any kind, either express or implied. We do not guarantee that the service will be uninterrupted, error-free, or secure.
legal.liabilityBody: To the fullest extent permitted by law, <entity></entity> shall not be liable for any indirect, incidental, special, consequential, or punitive damages arising out of or related to your use of {app}.
legal.termsChangesBody: We may update these Terms of Service from time to time. When we do, we will revise the "Last updated" date at the top of this page. Continued use of the service after changes constitutes acceptance of the updated terms.
legal.termsGoverningLawBody: These Terms of Service are governed by the laws of <jurisdiction></jurisdiction>.
legal.contactBody: For questions about these Terms of Service, contact us at <email></email>.
